        resp = apis.phone.search_text_messages(

            break

        if i>50:

all_lindsey_contacts = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_access_token, query='Lindsey', page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if isinstance(resp, list):
        page = resp
        next_page = None
    elif isinstance(resp, dict):
        page = resp.get('results') or resp.get('contacts') or resp.get('data') or []
        next_page = resp.get('next_page')
    else:
        page = []
        next_page = None

    if not page:
        break
    all_lindsey_contacts.extend(page)

    if isinstance(resp, dict) and next_page is not None:
        if not next_page:
            break
    page_index += 1
    if page_index > 50:
